headline: Callahan's Passage and Mooring County Flare as Island Fronts Fall Silent
war_summary: Fresh momentum has shifted the central fronts over the past two hours, marked by accelerating casualty rates and structural shifts in Callahan's Passage and Mooring County. In Callahan's Passage, severe fighting around Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage yielded a Colonial foothold amid heavy personnel losses. Simultaneously, Mooring County witnessed direct territorial movement as Colonial forces secured positions at MacConmara Barrows and Wiccwalk following sharp engagements. Weathered Expanse continues its grueling attrition unabated, logging thousands of casualties alongside recurring contests over Wightwalk and surrounding strongpoints. Along the western axis, Nevish Line reignited with renewed clashes near Grief Mother, maintaining an even division of bases across the sector. Conversely, the intense coastal and island fighting previously reported in Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row has dropped into a sudden lull, recording no base turnovers or notable casualties in the latest two-hour stretch.
